programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E11 — The Maternal Congruence Leonard is horrified when his mother, Beverly, turns up unannounced. His horror turns to anger when he learns that Sheldon knew about the visit and had found out about his parents' divorce before him.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E12 — The Psychic Vortex Sheldon and Raj go to a university party, Leonard disapproves of Penny's belief in psychics and Raj lusts after a girl named Abby whom he meets at the party.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E13 — The Bozeman Reaction Leonard and Sheldon's flat is burgled. Determined to outwit any thieves, the gang work on creating a state-of-the-art security system to protect the flat.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E14 — The Einstein Approximation Sheldon has 'theorist block' and is finding it difficult to muddle through a formula he's been working on. Taking inspiration from Albert Einstein, he takes a job at the Cheesecake Factory to try to kick-start his creativity.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E15 — The Large Hadron Collision Leonard is invited to Switzerland on Valentine's Day to see the world's largest particle accelerator. Sheldon is gutted when Leonard asks Penny to go with him, as a Valentine's Day treat, instead of him. Sheldon tries to coerce the couple into letting him take Penny's place, will they relent?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E16 — The Excelsior Acquisition Sheldon is summoned to court for driving through a red light while taking Penny to hospital in an earlier episode. He misses meeting Stan Lee, creator of 'Spider-Man', at the comic book store and riles the judge so much that he ends up in prison. Penny feels so guilty that Sheldon has missed out on the opportunity to meet Stan Lee that she finds out his home address and takes Sheldon there.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E17 — The Precious Fragmentation The gang squabble over a ring which they believe was used in 'The Lord of the Rings'. Leonard wants to give it back to its original owner, Koothrappali wants to sell it so that he can buy a jet ski, but Sheldon becomes obsessed with the ring and starts to turn into Gollum from The Lord of the Rings. Can the guys reach an agreement and will Sheldon return to normal?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E18 — The Pants Alternative Sheldon has been awarded a prestigious prize by the university but is scared of collecting the gong at a ceremony because he knows he'll have to give a speech. Penny tries to gee Sheldon up using rousing references to "X-Men" and Leonard and Koothrappali offer psychological guidance without much success. On the night, Sheldon's nerves get the better of him, and he has a drink before going on stage.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
